CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  August 23, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  Absent:  Nora Hernandez,
  Staff Present:  Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

ITEM 1: DRB MINUTES - August 9, 2022

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve the Minutes.

ITEM 2: 2933 Front Street
This application is for one-story addition to an existing single-family residence.

Applicant: Gabriel Flores, CAD 21 Design Group

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

Item 2 was pulled by the public - Jennifer Ng

ITEM 3: 2524 Hitchcock Drive
This application is for replacing an existing fence's topper and driveway gates for an existing single-
family residence.

Applicant: David Sifuentes

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

  1
 MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the Consent Agenda Items 1 and 3.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2: 2933 Front Street
This application is for one-story addition to an existing single-family residence.

Applicant: Gabriel Flores, CAD 21 Design Group

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

During public comments, Jennifer Ng stated that she was unsure of the small triangles on the roof
and if they were detriments to roof drainage. She also stated that black roof colors were not energy
efficient.

Daninger stated that he was concerned over the documentation of the columns at the entry.

The applicant stated that he would update the elevations accurately.

Abe clarified the column configuration. He also clarified that the roof triangles were crickets and
were not significantly problematic with drainage. Secondly, black color roof materials are common
and not detrimental to energy efficiency. It is roof insulation that is instrumental in radiant heat
management.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following condition:
  1) Update elevations to accurately illustrate columns.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

ITEM 4: 2620 Whitney Drive
This application is to legalize a new front yard fence for an existing single-family residence.

  2
 Applicants: Ronit Deri (owner), Zack Alaluf (Sky Builders)

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the confirmation that all
fencing is code compliant at a maximum of 3-foot height.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Tsai clarified the fence documentation/configuration and that there is a man gate proposed (not
shown on the site plan)

The applicant stated that the man gate is shown on a different plan.

Tsai also confirmed that the fence will abut the neighbor’s white fence.

Udani confirmed that the stepping of the height of the fence is to maintain a height compliant with
the 3’ height restriction.

Abe confirmed that there is an understanding with the neighbor that the existing and new fence sits
on the shared property line.

Udani confirmed with the applicant that the driveway gate will also be 3’ high.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The drawings shall be updated to be accurate and consistent across all plans.
  Drawings shall include all elevations of the new fence, include the missing segment
  of fence and the man gate;
  2. Drawings shall state the proposed 3’ high maximum height and;
  3. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit
  issuance.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

ITEM 5: 2708 West Birch Street
This application proposes a two-unit residential development on a single lot in the R-2 zone.
Applicant: Johnny Yu, Zhao Ting Pan

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that any required
MWELO compliant documentation be provided with the building department submittal.

  3
 ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Jennifer Ng in public comments stated that the project is light in Spanish detailing and the use of
shutters need greater consistency. Also, the accent color could be reconsidered.

Bert Ng in public comments stated that he had a challenge for the owner. He listed common
authentic Spanish detailing. He stated that in an R2 zone that 2 level homes are allowed. He also
stated that the design should include more arched windows as in Spanish Revival homes in this
neighborhood in the past.

Tsai commented that the entry elevation could be improved to strengthen the columns at the porch.
He also confirmed that the finial at the chimney was decorative.

The designer stated that there are numerous Spanish details including shutters, cornice treatment at
the rectangular openings and wing walls. He was surprised that the attention to detail was not
appreciated.

Daninger stated that there should be some attention to the shutters provided. He questioned further
the number of units and associated parking. This application complies with planning requirements.

Udani concurred with the need for a strategy for the use of window shutters. The designer stated
that the shutters were primarily accents for the second floor since the first-floor windows are within
the porches. Discussion ensued regarding the front facing (south) elevation at the street. Udani stated
that the top left window should have shutters as well.

There was discussion on the accent color for the project. The designer stated that he wanted a more
Mediterranean aqua color. The Board had no objection.

Abe stated that staff worked with the applicant to establish a specific architectural style. Although
not purist in all detailing there is adequate scale and detail to reasonably represent the architectural
intent. Especially given the R-2 representation of buildings on the street.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1) MWELO documents shall be provided as needed prior to building department
  submittal.
  2) Shutters shall be provided on upper left window on the south elevation
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

  4
 ITEM 6: 204 Palatine Drive
This application is for a new two-story single-family residence with a detached garage on a vacant
lot.

Applicants: David Angelo, Michael Chang

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that MWELO
compliant landscape documents be submitted during building plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was absent and the item was continued.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to continue the application due to the absence of the applicant.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

ADJOURNMENT:
There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:19 P.M. to the next meeting on
September 13, 2022.

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:19
 •  Seconded by Tsai
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 13th day of September, 2022

  Ankit Udani, Chairman
